section_summary: This section records U.S. decisions on visits by Japanese fisheries and fur-seal vessels to Alaska and the Philippines in 1937–1938. Officials refused the Hakuho Maru access to closed western Aleutian harbors in 1937, while allowing calls at open ports and extending courtesies to other vessels. In 1938, after a salmon fisheries arrangement with Japan, they allowed the Hakuho Maru to enter two closed harbors only in urgent need, without setting a precedent.

subfiles.title: Conversation on Japanese vessel visits
subfiles.about: Officials discuss requests for the Hakuho Maru and Hakuyo Maru to visit Alaskan islands.
subfiles.summary: Hill opposes the Hakuho Maru’s western Aleutian visits. Participants favor sympathetic reconsideration of the Hakuyo Maru’s Pribilof visit.

subfiles.title: Immigration courtesies for Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Immigration officials will extend lawful courtesies during the Hakuyo Maru’s Alaska calls.
subfiles.summary: Immigration personnel are instructed to assist the vessel at St. Paul Island and Dutch Harbor.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: The War Department acknowledges the Hakuyo Maru’s itinerary.
subfiles.summary: It has no jurisdiction at St. Paul Island but forwards the information to its Ninth Corps Area commander.

subfiles.title: Interior Department reply on Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Interior explains its lack of personnel at the Pribilof Islands.
subfiles.summary: The Bureau of Fisheries has jurisdiction over the islands and their fur-seal industry.

subfiles.title: Japanese request to reconsider Hakuho Maru harbor visits
subfiles.about: Japan seeks renewed permission for the Hakuho Maru to investigate fur-seal migration in the western Aleutians.
subfiles.summary: The Embassy disputes U.S. claims about seal migration and requests access to three harbors. If refused, it proposes a Dutch Harbor call.

subfiles.title: State Department inquiry to Navy on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: State seeks Navy advice on Japan’s renewed harbor request.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese note is forwarded for advice on western Aleutian visits and a possible Dutch Harbor call.

subfiles.title: State Department inquiry to Commerce on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: State seeks Commerce advice on Japan’s renewed harbor request.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese note is forwarded for advice on western Aleutian visits and a possible Dutch Harbor call.

subfiles.title: Reply refusing western Aleutian visits
subfiles.about: The United States rejects the treaty basis for Hakuho Maru visits to closed harbors.
subfiles.summary: U.S. observations do not place fur seals near the requested islands, so the proposed calls do not fall under the Fur Seals Convention. The note addresses a possible Dutch Harbor visit.

subfiles.title: Consular report on Hakuyo Maru clearance
subfiles.about: The consulate reports health and crew-list clearance for the Hakuyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: The vessel expects to call at Dutch Harbor in July, with possible visits to Nome and Unalaska.

subfiles.title: Policy memorandum on Japanese Aleutian visits
subfiles.about: State weighs treaty, naval, and fisheries concerns raised by Japanese vessel requests.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum questions Japan’s treaty grounds for visits to remote harbors and records Navy concerns about surveying and salmon fishing. It also warns that refusal could affect the Fur Seals Treaty and negotiations over Alaskan fisheries. It recommends reconsidering the Hakuyo Maru’s Pribilof visit and consulting Navy and Fisheries before deciding the Hakuho Maru request.

subfiles.title: Treasury courtesies for Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Customs officials are authorized to assist the Hakuyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: The Juneau collector will extend courtesies at St. Paul Island and Dutch Harbor.

subfiles.title: Navy rejects Hakuho Maru’s closed-harbor visits
subfiles.about: Navy maintains its objection to western Aleutian visits.
subfiles.summary: Navy recommends refusal of the closed-harbor calls but has no objection to Dutch Harbor.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Shonan Maru Philippine visits
subfiles.about: Japan requests visits to Philippine ports for a fishing-industry investigation.
subfiles.summary: The Shonan Maru proposes calls at Manila, Davao, and Zamboanga.

subfiles.title: State inquiry to War on Shonan Maru
subfiles.about: State asks War to consider courtesies for the Shonan Maru’s Philippine calls.
subfiles.summary: The proposed Manila, Davao, and Zamboanga schedule is forwarded.

subfiles.title: State notice to Commerce on Shonan Maru
subfiles.about: State informs Commerce of proposed Shonan Maru visits.
subfiles.summary: The vessel’s Philippine itinerary and fishing-industry purpose are described.

subfiles.title: State notice to Navy on Shonan Maru
subfiles.about: State informs Navy of proposed Shonan Maru visits.
subfiles.summary: The proposed Philippine itinerary is forwarded while War considers courtesies.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Shonan Maru request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the proposed Philippine calls.
subfiles.summary: Hull says federal authorities have been consulted and a decision will follow.

subfiles.title: Approval of Shonan Maru Philippine visits
subfiles.about: The United States approves the Shonan Maru’s proposed itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Usual courtesies and facilities will be extended at Manila, Davao, and Zamboanga.

subfiles.title: Commerce reply on Shonan Maru
subfiles.about: Commerce raises no objection to the Philippine visits.
subfiles.summary: Commerce agrees to calls at Manila, Davao, and Zamboanga.

subfiles.title: Hakuho Maru Dutch Harbor arrival notice
subfiles.about: Japan supplies the Hakuho Maru’s Dutch Harbor dates.
subfiles.summary: The Embassy reports the vessel’s planned arrival and departure.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on Shonan Maru
subfiles.about: War arranges courtesies for the Shonan Maru.
subfiles.summary: The Philippine Department and insular authorities are notified of the scheduled calls.

subfiles.title: Commerce reply on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Commerce recommends denying the Hakuho Maru access to western Aleutian harbors.
subfiles.summary: Its seal records do not support the proposed research calls; Dutch Harbor is acceptable.

subfiles.title: Customs arrangements for Hakuho Maru
subfiles.to: Assistant Chief, Division of Protocol and Conferences
subfiles.about: Customs authorizes courtesies at Dutch Harbor.
subfiles.summary: The Juneau collector is instructed to assist the Hakuho Maru’s June 30 call.

subfiles.title: Navy reply on Shonan Maru
subfiles.about: Navy addresses the Shonan Maru’s Philippine itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities are notified to extend usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: First revised Shonan Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: Japan requests approval for later Philippine port dates.
subfiles.summary: New calls are proposed for August and September.

subfiles.title: State notice to War on revised Shonan Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: State forwards the first revised itinerary.
subfiles.summary: War is asked to arrange courtesies under the changed schedule.

subfiles.title: State notice to Navy on revised Shonan Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: State forwards the first revised itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Navy is informed of changed Philippine port dates.

subfiles.title: State notice to Commerce on revised Shonan Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: State forwards the first revised itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Commerce is asked to consider the changed Philippine port dates.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of revised Shonan Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the changed Shonan Maru schedule.
subfiles.summary: Hull says the relevant federal authorities have been contacted.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of revised Shonan Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: Navy approves the changed port dates.
subfiles.summary: No objection is raised to the Shonan Maru’s revised schedule.

subfiles.title: Commerce approval of revised Shonan Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: Commerce approves the changed port dates.
subfiles.summary: Commerce has no objection to later visits at Manila, Davao, and Zamboanga.

subfiles.title: War Department action on revised Shonan Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: War communicates the revised itinerary to its Philippine command.
subfiles.summary: A radiogram advises the commanding general of the changes.

subfiles.title: Second revised Shonan Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: Japan requests another change to the Shonan Maru’s Philippine schedule.
subfiles.summary: The ship now proposes Manila on August 9–11, Davao on August 25–28, and Zamboanga on September 11–13.

subfiles.title: Approval of second revised Shonan Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: The United States accepts the Shonan Maru’s latest dates.
subfiles.summary: Federal authorities agree to the revised visits and usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Embassy forwards Hakuyo Maru thanks
subfiles.about: The embassy transmits thanks for treatment of the Hakuyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: An enclosed Fisheries Institute letter thanks American authorities for courtesies.

subfiles.title: Fisheries Institute letter of thanks
subfiles.about: The institute thanks U.S. authorities for assisting the Hakuyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Sugiura reports courteous treatment at St. Paul and Dutch Harbor and the vessel’s safe return to Tokyo.

subfiles.title: Hakuyo Maru request for Manila visit
subfiles.about: Japan requests a Manila call during the Hakuyo Maru’s training cruise.
subfiles.summary: Captain Jinzo Nakagawa plans a January 1–5, 1938 visit.

subfiles.title: State request to War on Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: State requests usual courtesies for the Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: War is asked to facilitate the Hakuyo Maru’s January call if unobjectionable.

subfiles.title: State notice to Navy on Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: State informs Navy of the planned Manila call.
subfiles.summary: The Hakuyo Maru’s dates, command, crew, and student complement are forwarded.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Hakuyo Maru Manila request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges Japan’s Manila visit request.
subfiles.summary: Federal authorities are being consulted before a decision.

subfiles.title: War Department arrangements for Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: War arranges Philippine courtesies for the Hakuyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: The Philippine command and insular authorities receive the request.

subfiles.title: Approval of Hakuyo Maru Manila visit
subfiles.about: The United States approves the Hakuyo Maru’s Manila call.
subfiles.summary: Usual courtesies and facilities will be extended.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of Hakuyo Maru Manila visit
subfiles.about: Navy raises no objection to the Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities are notified to extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: Hakuyo Maru revised Manila arrival
subfiles.about: Japan changes the Hakuyo Maru’s arrival from January 1 to January 5.
subfiles.summary: The Embassy asks whether the new date is agreeable.

subfiles.title: State notice to Navy on revised Hakuyo Maru arrival
subfiles.about: State reports the revised January 5 arrival.
subfiles.summary: Navy is informed of the Hakuyo Maru’s changed Manila schedule.

subfiles.title: State notice to War on revised Hakuyo Maru arrival
subfiles.about: State reports the revised January 5 arrival.
subfiles.summary: War is informed of the Hakuyo Maru’s changed Manila schedule.

subfiles.title: Approval of revised Hakuyo Maru arrival
subfiles.about: The United States accepts the January 5 arrival.
subfiles.summary: Appropriate authorities have been notified of the change.

subfiles.title: Navy reply on revised Hakuyo Maru arrival
subfiles.about: Navy accepts the changed arrival date.
subfiles.summary: Navy has no objection to arrival on January 5 rather than January 1.

subfiles.title: War reply on revised Hakuyo Maru arrival
subfiles.about: War informs Philippine authorities of the changed arrival.
subfiles.summary: A radiogram instructs the Philippine command to extend usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Suma’s oral observation on Hakuho Maru request
subfiles.about: Suma links Japan’s Aleutian request to cooperation over Alaska salmon fisheries.
subfiles.summary: He asks for favorable and prompt consideration of the attached request.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Hakuho Maru emergency harbor access
subfiles.about: Japan seeks advance permission for emergency calls at two western Aleutian harbors.
subfiles.summary: The Hakuho Maru will study fur-seal migration and poaching. The Embassy requests access to Chichagof Harbor and Nazan Bay for shelter or water.

subfiles.title: Policy memorandum on 1938 Hakuho Maru request
subfiles.about: State reassesses the harbor request after the Alaska salmon fisheries agreement.
subfiles.summary: Previous objections remain, including survey opportunities and concern among Pacific Coast fisheries interests. Refusal could affect Japan’s cooperation on fur seals and salmon. The memorandum recommends consultation with Navy and Fisheries.

subfiles.title: State inquiry to Navy on 1938 Hakuho Maru request
subfiles.about: State seeks Navy advice on emergency harbor access.
subfiles.summary: The Embassy’s request for Chichagof Harbor and Nazan Bay is forwarded.

subfiles.title: State inquiry to Commerce on 1938 Hakuho Maru request
subfiles.about: State seeks Commerce advice on emergency harbor access.
subfiles.summary: The Embassy’s request for Chichagof Harbor and Nazan Bay is forwarded.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of 1938 Hakuho Maru request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the request for emergency harbor access.
subfiles.summary: A decision will follow replies from the interested federal departments.

subfiles.title: State notice to Agriculture on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies if the Hakuho Maru needs shelter or water.
subfiles.summary: Agriculture is informed of the proposed Aleutian cruise.

subfiles.title: State notice to Interior on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies if the Hakuho Maru needs shelter or water.
subfiles.summary: Interior is informed of the proposed Aleutian cruise.

subfiles.title: State notice to Labor on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies if the Hakuho Maru needs shelter or water.
subfiles.summary: Labor is informed of the proposed Aleutian cruise.

subfiles.title: State notice to War on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies if the Hakuho Maru needs shelter or water.
subfiles.summary: War is informed of the proposed Aleutian cruise.

subfiles.title: State notice to Treasury on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies if the Hakuho Maru needs shelter or water.
subfiles.summary: Treasury is informed of the proposed Aleutian cruise.

subfiles.title: Conditional permission for Hakuho Maru harbor visits
subfiles.about: The United States conditionally permits emergency entry into two closed Aleutian harbors.
subfiles.summary: The Hakuho Maru may enter Chichagof Harbor or Nazan Bay only in urgent need of shelter or water. The permission sets no precedent; Unalaska remains the area’s open port.

subfiles.title: Commerce reassessment of Hakuho Maru request
subfiles.about: Commerce weighs its seal evidence against the recent salmon fisheries arrangement.
subfiles.summary: Commerce still finds no fur-seal research justification for western Aleutian calls. It favors permission to avoid harming Japanese cooperation on Bristol Bay salmon and suggests supervision by Navy or Coast Guard vessels.

subfiles.title: Navy conditions for Hakuho Maru access
subfiles.about: Navy recommends narrowly limited emergency access.
subfiles.summary: It proposes urgent-necessity entry to two closed harbors, no precedent, and use of open-port Unalaska when possible.

subfiles.title: Immigration courtesies for Hakuho Maru
subfiles.from: Deputy Commissioner of Immigration and Naturalization
subfiles.about: Immigration officials will assist the Hakuho Maru if it calls at the requested harbors.
subfiles.summary: Courtesies are subject to immigration laws and regulations.
